village_arrive.text: The village is quiet -- too quiet. Most doors are barred, and the few people you see hurry past with their heads down. Only one building shows signs of life: a crooked shop with a faded sign reading 'Provisions & Curiosities'.

choices.text: Use your charm to get information.

villager_talk.text: A hunched woman glances at you nervously. "Strangers aren't welcome here. Not since the creatures started coming from the forest." She hurries away before you can ask more.
villager_talk.speaker: Villager

persuade_villager.text: You catch a villager's eye and speak calmly. Something in your voice puts him at ease. "The forest... it's been corrupted. Goblins are just the beginning. There's something darker driving them." He presses a small coin purse into your hand. "Take this. You'll need it more than me."
persuade_villager.speaker: Villager

choices.text: Thank him and head to the shop.

meet_merchant.text: Inside, an old man peers at you from behind a cluttered counter. Trinkets, potions, and a few weapons line the shelves. "Ah, customers! Rare these days." He eyes your bruised armor. "Looks like you could use some supplies, Godsent."
meet_merchant.speaker: Old Merchant

choices.text: "How do you know who I am?"

merchant_knows.text: "Word travels fast when the sky tears open and spits out a person. Besides, I've been in this business long enough to recognize someone who doesn't belong." He grins, revealing missing teeth. "Now, shall we do business?"
merchant_knows.speaker: Old Merchant

open_shop.text: The merchant gestures broadly at his shelves. Potions glow faintly on one side, and a rusty but serviceable sword hangs on the wall.
open_shop.speaker: Old Merchant

after_shop.text: "Take care out there, Godsent. The forest is just the beginning. Whatever corrupted it is still out there." The merchant waves you off with a knowing look.
after_shop.speaker: Old Merchant

choices.text: Leave the village and continue your journey.

story_end.text:
You step out of the village and back into the wilds. The road ahead is long and uncertain. But you are the Godsent -- and your journey has only begun.

-- To be continued --
